candidates.formal_type:
∀ (n : Nat) (la : n.Partition) (σ : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)),
  Eq.{1} (Etingof.spechtModuleCharacter n la σ)
    (Etingof.MvLaurent.coeff (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.expEmbed n) (Etingof.Nat.Partition.toFinsupp la))
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.frobeniusLaurentFactor n)
        (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.toLaurent n) (Etingof.cycleTypePsumProduct n σ))))

∀ (n : Nat) (e : Finsupp.{0, 0} (Fin n) Nat) (P : MvPolynomial.{0, 0} (Fin n) Complex),
  Eq.{1}
    (Etingof.MvLaurent.coeff (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.expEmbed n) e)
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.frobeniusLaurentFactor n) (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.toLaurent n) P)))
    (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} Equiv.Perm.sign.{0} Fin.revPerm))
      (MvPolynomial.coeff.{0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} e (Etingof.rhoShift n))
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.vandermondePoly n) P)))
